entities.name: Ribosomal protein eS1
observations: The 212-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt reference A3DMT5 from Staphylothermus marinus; identity and coverage are both 100%, E-value 6e-150.
The sequence contains the Ribosomal_S3Ae Pfam domain (PF01015.24), spanning residues 6–193 with i-Evalue 8.1e-74.
Related reviewed archaeal eS1 proteins show 64.6–71.3% identity across approximately 95–99% of the sequence.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight approximately 24.58 kDa, predicted pI 10.07, and positive charge at pH 7 approximately +19.85.
Curated functional annotations associate eS1 with the ribosome, structural constitution of the ribosome, and translation.

entities.name: Translation
observations: Ribosomal protein eS1 is annotated as a structural constituent of the ribosome and participates in translation.

entities.name: Ribosome
observations: The exact-match reference protein is annotated as a component of the ribosome; the protein is therefore expected to be ribosome-associated rather than freely soluble.
